notes: MiscPlan.md has four unresolved conflicts: (1) safe-point cleanup ordering, (2) remediation lineage preservation, (3) attempt-scoped evidence retention, (4) orphan cleanup/crew runtime contracts not owned anywhere else in the doc set.
